Established in 2007, Shramik Shanti Campus (SSC), located in Chyasal, Lalitpur, is a constituent campus of Pokhara University. Originally a community-based, non-profit institution affiliated with Tribhuvan University offering BBS and MBS programs, it transitioned to Pokhara University in 2025 and expanded its academic offerings to include programs in Law, Information Technology, and Artificial Intelligence. The campus provides undergraduate and graduate programs under the Faculties of Management
